overall_notes: The extraction was mostly accurate. The paper clearly addresses NLG tasks (language modeling, domain adaptation, citation generation) and uses both automatic metrics and human/LLM evaluation. Main issues were redundancy in extracted lists and some inconsistent naming. The paper is well-structured with comprehensive evaluation across multiple dimensions.
